جُزْأَةٌ The handle of the [kind of awl called] مِخْصَف, (S, K,) and of the إِشْفِى: (S:) AZ says that it is not [the handle, or hilt,] of the sword, nor of the dagger; but is the handle of the مِئْثَرَة with which camels' feet are branded. (TA.) [See also ضَبَّةٌ.] ―
-b2- A vine-prop; (K, TA;) a piece of wood with which a vine is raised from the ground. (TA.) ―
-b3- In the dial. of the tribe of Sheybán, The hinder, or hindermost, شُقَّة [or oblong piece of cloth] of a tent. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
